rationale: The short thesis is working and structurally intact — price just broke the prior day low with the heaviest recent volume (31.5k shares on the $39.94 breakdown bar), every bounce is being sold beneath the falling 9-EMA ($40.34) and far below VWAP ($42.06), establishing a clear lower-high sequence (40.49 → 40.20) while SPY weakness and VIXY strength still support downside follow-through toward the $39.40 target.
